name: Strapi Cloud
description: Strapi Cloud is a managed hosting platform for Strapi, an open-source headless content management system. Teams use it to model structured content, manage editorial drafts, and deliver content to websites, apps, and other digital experiences through generated APIs.
agentUseSummary: Enter a dedicated Strapi Content API token once, choose the Strapi Cloud project address and the exact content types agents may use, then let agents read bounded documents, prepare changes, create or update drafts, and publish a reviewed draft under Safe or Dangerous policy. Relay keeps the token encrypted, pins requests to the selected strapiapp.com project and content-type allowlist, and does not expose deletion, uploads, administration, arbitrary filtering or population, GraphQL, custom endpoints, or raw API access.

credentialRequirements.name: STRAPI_CLOUD_INSTANCE_URL
credentialRequirements.label: Strapi Cloud address
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the exact public HTTPS project address ending in strapiapp.com. Relay pins this connection to that project.

credentialRequirements.name: STRAPI_CLOUD_ALLOWED_API_IDS
credentialRequirements.label: Allowed content types
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the plural API IDs agents may use, separated by commas, such as articles,authors.

credentialRequirements.name: STRAPI_CLOUD_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Content API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated Custom token in Settings > Global settings > API Tokens with only the selected content types and required find, findOne, create, and update permissions.

providerSetup.nextAction: A project administrator enables Draft & Publish on the selected content types, creates a dedicated expiring Custom Content API token with least-privilege endpoint permissions, enters the project address, allowed plural API IDs, and token, then Relay runs health, bounded reads, Safe approval checks, Dangerous draft create/update, explicit publication, token revocation, and disconnect checks.

evidence.supports: Strapi Content API tokens authenticate external clients, are separate from Admin tokens, support Read-only, Full access, or Custom endpoint permissions and configurable expiry, and use Bearer authentication.

Strapi 5 generates collection Content API routes for bounded list, get, create, update, and delete operations, uses stable documentId identifiers and flattened data, and accepts writes inside a data envelope.
The REST Content API distinguishes draft and published versions with the status parameter; drafts return publishedAt null.
Draft & Publish is enabled per content type, new content is a draft when enabled, and Content APIs can request, create, update, and delete draft or published content through the status parameter.
Strapi Cloud CLI browser login is a first-party project link and deployment workflow, not a documented public third-party Content API OAuth application grant.
